environment.notes: Release build required for interpretation. Metal instanced quads; CPU fixed-step physics. Submission times are elapsed wall time including drawable/semaphore waits, not process CPU utilization. GPU execution is command-buffer time, not display latency. Missed refreshes are estimates from callback spacing. RSS is a post-trial snapshot, not peak memory. No automatic energy measurements. Trials stop on backgrounding; thermal state is recorded. Codec viewport is 1179×1179 physical pixels.
